A '''minder''' was an occupation similar to a therapist or a [[psychiatrist]].

[[Klo Merit]], an [[Equani]], was a minder stationed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the soggy [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]].
